verdict.rationale: The evidence shows Amplitude Experiment has a management API with reference docs and a published OpenAPI spec. Nothing shows an interactive API explorer or runnable 'try it' examples. A static API reference and a machine-readable spec are adjacent building blocks, not the interactive, runnable reference the story asks for. The 'hands-on demo' item is a product demo, not an API reference.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
